description: Erection of a single storey side extension, side and rear roof extensions with front roof window and retention of detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (19-000 P001, received 04/01/2021 and 19-000 P002 (revA), received 11/03/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved drawings/material.

Condition : 4 - The side extension and outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the '145 Popes Lane, W5 4ND' described at the top of this decision letter and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes. The outbuilding shall not contain any primary living accommodation (bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens/living rooms).

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the side dormer shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
